input.summary: Remove three-year take-or-pay minimum commitment; pay for Services used or ordered only
input.comment: [Playbook] We removed the three-year USD 2,000,000 take-or-pay commitment so that we pay only for Services used or ordered, consistent with our position against minimum commitments without an exit; as drafted it also contradicts § 12.3 (no minimum-volume commitment) and § 9.4 (our 30-day convenience termination right). If a commitment is commercially necessary, we can discuss one limited to the current 12-month term, reducible on 30 days' notice with a true-up rather than a penalty.

ops.oldText: Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
ops.newText: Customer will pay only for Services used or ordered during the applicable term. Customer has no minimum purchase, take-or-pay, or shortfall obligation.
